name: PigRunner
description: A colorful endless runner game. Jump in and see how far you can go.
overview: PigRunner is a side-scrolling endless runner built with libGDX and compiled to the web with GWT. It features physics-based jumping, procedurally generated hills, coin collection, particle effects and sound, all running at a smooth frame rate in the browser.
features: Menu, HUD and game-over screens with a custom UI skin
Runs in any modern browser, no install needed
benefits: Production-ready libGDX project structure you can reuse for your own games
Clean separation of screens, game world, rendering and input
Single codebase that targets web, desktop, Android and iOS
A good reference for texture atlases, shaders and audio in libGDX

includes: Gradle build for web, desktop, Android and iOS
Placeholder art so the project builds
excludes: Game name, logo and store listing

requirements.label: IDE
requirements.value: Android Studio or IntelliJ IDEA (iOS builds need a Mac with Xcode)
